body:
Triage: `pm:queue`, `domain:devx`, type Bug. Root `package.json` delegate names a script `apps/docs` never declared (`start` vs `site:start`), broken since the introducing commit `159e29944` — a named landing spot with a measured loud failure, nothing to ask.

S-level mechanical card. Scope per the card: the one-word delegate fix, plus the quick grep for any prose telling a reader to run `pnpm docs:start` (if hits exist they are part of the same fix; if none, say so in the PR body). `skip-changeset` applies if the diff stays root-manifest + docs only.

Triage: this comment is from the triage seat (scheduled run) — no claim.

```json
  "summary": "Re-derived the defect from origin/main (HEAD 4e3a4c3c8): pnpm docs:start fails with ERR_PNPM_RECURSIVE_RUN_NO_SCRIPT because apps/docs/package.json declares site:start, not start. Determined the app's script name is the outlier, not the root delegate: apps/docs/README.md already documents 'pnpm start' as the local equivalent of 'pnpm docs:start' (right beside dev/build), matching the root's two already-working docs:dev->dev / docs:build->build delegates; no file in the repo references site:start outside apps/docs/package.json itself. Fixed by renaming site:start to start in apps/docs/package.json; root package.json required no change since docs:start was already correctly named.",
  "tests": "Reproduced the failure at origin/main HEAD 4e3a4c3c8 in a clean worktree: `pnpm docs:start` -> ERR_PNPM_RECURSIVE_RUN_NO_SCRIPT, exit 1 (verbatim match of the issue's quoted error). Applied the fix, committed (final HEAD 5fd08318d). Built the docs site (`pnpm docs:build`, exit 0, 1184 static pages) under the shared heavy-verify lock, then started it on a random port (`PORT=48174 pnpm docs:start`): printed '✓ Ready in 153ms', and `curl -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}'` returned 200 with the real docs homepage HTML (title 'ObjectStack — A complete business system in 16k tokens'). Re-ran the same success check after the final commit at 5fd08318d to match the reported sha. Server killed by PID afterward and re-curled to confirm the port closed -- no server left running. `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs apps/docs/package.json`: 0 gate families name this path directly. `pnpm check:nul-bytes` (applies to any edit): green at HEAD 5fd08318d. Confirmed apps/docs/package.json is valid JSON post-edit. skip-changeset label applied (union with the labeler bot's pre-existing documentation/dependencies/size:xs) and read back to confirm: [\"documentation\",\"dependencies\",\"size/xs\",\"skip-changeset\"].",
  "open_questions": [],
  "out_of_scope_findings": []
}
```
